items.headline: Chicago Fed President Goolsbee rejects calls for Fed rate cuts to ease US debt burden
items.teaser: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee rejected calls for interest-rate cuts to ease the US government’s debt burden, warning that such a …
items.story: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee rejected calls for interest-rate cuts to ease the US government’s debt burden, warning that such a move could fuel inflation and raise borrowing costs. He said the debate reinforces the importance of Federal Reserve independence.

items.headline: Strong profit growth prompted Moneyview to reduce IPO size: MD & CEO Agrawal
items.teaser: Moneyview reduced its public offer to Rs 1,092 crore from Rs 1,500 crore. This decision stems from robust profit growth and adequate inte…
items.story: Moneyview reduced its public offer to Rs 1,092 crore from Rs 1,500 crore. This decision stems from robust profit growth and adequate internal cash generation. The company fixed its price band at Rs 32-34 per equity share for the IPO. The IPO comprises a fresh issue and an offer for sale by existing shareholders. Proceeds will fuel lending business growth and new product development.

items.headline: Mastercard Asia-Pacific to sell entire stake worth nearly  ₹890 crore: Report
items.teaser: Mastercard will liquidate its holdings in Pine Labs through a ₹890 crore deal, offering shares at ₹179.50 on 22 September. This action co…
items.story: Mastercard will liquidate its holdings in Pine Labs through a ₹890 crore deal, offering shares at ₹179.50 on 22 September. This action coincides with Pine Labs' stock recovery and profit growth from increased digital payment adoption and UPI usage in India.

items.story: ലേബര്‍കോഡ്: 'മുഖ്യമന്ത്രിയുടേത് സംഘപരിവാര്‍ അജണ്ട നടപ്പാക്കാനുള്ള വ്യഗ്രത'; പിണറായി വിജയന്‍ Reporter Tv‘ലേബർ കോ‍ഡ് നടപ്പിലാക്കാൻ മുഖ്യമന്ത്രിയ്ക്ക് വ്യഗ്രത; പെട്ടെന്നുള്ള പ്രഖ്യാപനം ആരെ തൃപ്തിപ്പെടുത്താനെന്ന് പറയേണ്ടതില്ല’ Manorama Online'ലേബർ കോഡ് നടപ്പാക്കുമെന്ന പ്രഖ്യാപനം ആരെ തൃപ്തിപ്പെടുത്താൻ, നിയമനിർമാണത്തിന് LDF സർക്കാരിന് സമയം കിട്ടിയില്ല’ Mathrubhumiകോൺഗ്രസിൻ്റെ ദേശീയ നേതൃത്വം എതിർത്ത ലേബർ കോഡ് കേരളത്തിൽ നടപ്പിലാക്കുമെന്ന് വി ഡി സതീശൻ Reporter Tvപാര്‍ലമെന്റ് പാസാക്കിയ നിയമം നടപ്പിലാക്കാത

items.headline: Jupiter uses a surprisingly complex system to fend off particles from the sun
items.teaser: A University of Iowa-led research team has reported in a new study the most detailed observations to date of the bow shock at Jupiter, ou…
items.story: A University of Iowa-led research team has reported in a new study the most detailed observations to date of the bow shock at Jupiter, our solar system's gas giant. The findings from NASA's Juno mission reveal key differences between Jupiter's bow shock and Earth's. They also may lead to a better understanding of the physics of how shocks function in even more powerful energy releases, such as those from dying stars. The research is published in Nature Communications.

items.story: A drop of coffee on a tabletop often leaves a dark ring behind. This everyday mark is a reminder that a drying droplet is not passive: As water evaporates, it can transport the particles suspended inside it toward the edge. Scientists call this the coffee-ring effect. For inkjet printing and surface coatings, however, a ring is often exactly what engineers do not want. They need the material to land in a controlled, predictable pattern.

items.story: Scientists have found evidence that black holes of vastly different sizes may launch powerful jets according to the same universal rule. Supermassive black holes can produce jets soon after tearing apart a star, then fire up again hundreds or thousands of days later when their feeding rate drops to about 2% of the Eddington limit. That same threshold is known to trigger jets from much smaller black holes in the Milky Way.
